118612.name: Chabad of Monterey
118612.note: Monterey County Now (Dec 2024): Rabbi Dovid Holtzberg: 'In 2003, he found himself living on the Monterey Peninsula'; AZ Jewish Post (2019): 'For the past 16 years, the Holtzbergs ... have served'. lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010 lists it at 2707 David Avenue, Pacific Grove; it is now at 620 Lighthouse Avenue #100, Pacific Grove, so it moved after Aug 2010 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 2707 David Avenue, Pacific Grove (its address in lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010)

155894.name: Chabad of S. Clemente
155894.note: Orange County Register, June 22 2013: 'For almost nine years, the Chabad Jewish Center of San Clemente has traveled from place to place', so about 2004; San Clemente Patch: Rabbi Mendel Slavin has directed it 'since 2004'; the listing number points to about 2004. (His LinkedIn starts Sept 2005.) lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010 lists it at the Best Western Hotel, San Clemente (where it met in 2010); it is now at 1306 North El Camino Real, so it moved after Aug 2010 (when, not found).

earlier.where: the Best Western Hotel, San Clemente (where it met in 2010) (its address in lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010)

174719.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Tustin
174719.note: In the 2016-2017 Jewish OC Community Directory (Orange County Jewish Life, http://jlifesgpv.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/JOCCD-2016-FINAL-OCJL-1.pdf): 'Chabad of Tustin ... Rabbi Shuey Eliezrie Founded: 2004. Serving Tustin area and Chapman University.' A directory's year, so medium (therebbesimpact.com: 2003; the listing number points to about 2005). Found by Firecrawl's research agent; checked in the PDF. lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010 lists it at 2351 Sunningdale Dr., Tustin; it is now at 13112 Newport Avenue, Suite H, so it moved after Aug 2010 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 2351 Sunningdale Dr., Tustin (its address in lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010)

441914.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Oakland
441914.note: The center's own history page: 'In 2006 Rabbi Dovid & Shulamis Labkowski established the Chabad Jewish Center of Oakland & Piedmont'; its About page: 'our current organization was founded in 2006'. (The same page traces Lubavitch families in Oakland back to Rabbi Shlomo DovBer Goldberg, who came in 1900; not a Chabad center.) lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010 lists it at 3718 Grand Avenue, Suite 1, Oakland; it is now at 3014 Lakeshore Avenue, so it moved after Aug 2010 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 3718 Grand Avenue, Suite 1, Oakland (its address in lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010)

286269.note: The center's own About page: 'in 2005 Rabbi Raleigh Resnick and his wife Fruma founded Chabad of The Tri-Valley'; Pleasanton Weekly (June 2025): founded 'out of their home in 2005'; Danville San Ramon (2023): the Resnicks 'arrived in Pleasanton in 2005'. lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010 lists it at 784 Palomino Drive, Pleasanton (also its address in J.'s Resource Guide 2012); it is now at 3370 Hopyard Road, so it moved after 2012 (when, not found).
